description: A card a collector wants to acquire. Mirrored from the SwapPulse Wishlist entity so wishlists are portable across PDSs and enable cross-instance trade matching. Visibility is enforced by the SwapPulse AppView membership-check layer — the record is published to the PDS but only visible to the owner via the AppView.

main.description: A single wishlist entry for a wanted card.

cardUri.description: TCGDex card id (canonical reference to the catalog record)

maxPrice.description: Max willing to pay in pence

ownerDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the wishlist owner (embedded so the record is self-describing on the network)
